subject: Hook Horror
picture: A hook horror stands in a dungeon hall. Official look: vulture-like bony head and beak, no lips, two large hook-blades instead of hands, thick beetle-like plated body, two legs with clawed feet. It stands on the floor facing the viewer. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
